wish: someone should make an app that draws star charts
spec:
Draws an all-sky chart of the bright stars and constellation figures above the horizon for any place, date and time.
Pick a city or type latitude and longitude (or tap My location), set date and time, tap Draw; save the chart as SVG or print it.
It does not show the Moon, planets or faint stars, and times are in this device's time zone.
notes: Embedded catalog of about 200 bright stars (J2000, no precession) and 42 constellation figures; stereographic projection, north up, east left.
